name: Sesamoiditis / Hallux Sesamoid Stress Injury
definition: Painful overload or stress injury of the sesamoid complex beneath the first metatarsal head.

investigations.principle: MRI detects stress reaction/AVN; CT can characterize fracture; dedicated radiographs may assist.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when the condition-specific question requires soft-tissue, neural, marrow or occult-injury assessment.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs/CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

amber: Persistent fracture or AVN requires specialist review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada/Asthi-Sandhi load-related phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Painful overload or stress injury of the sesamoid complex beneath the first metatarsal head.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for major trauma, acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
